audit.whatIsWrong: report[14].t quoted 50.65%; the packet says 54.36% over 344 games.

audit.why: Even at 1 (both melee), Yi's from 2 to 5, even at 6 when her range unlocks, Yi's at first item, Kayle's at 2+. Chart matches the packet and full/content agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No change to the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was treated as a constant threat with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: It is 160/120/80s. At rank 1 a baited ult removes her only survival tool for nearly three minutes — that is the whole shape of the lane and it was never stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t attribute the ranged poke and the slow to Starfire Spellblade (E). E is a 550-range auto-attack reset that scales on the target's MISSING health; the 900-range slow is Radiant Blast (Q), which also shreds resistances. content.late and spikes[3].text also credit Kayle with true damage — her damage is magic.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q pierces, slowing, damaging and reducing resistances; E's active smites the next attack for bonus damage proportionate to missing health. The resist shred matters because Wuju Style's true damage ignores it entirely, which is a real edge nobody had written down.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t rewritten with the correct owners, ranges and cooldowns; content.late and spikes[3].text corrected to magic damage. Starfire Spellblade named as the auto-reset burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing despite Celestial Blessing.
audit.why: Kayle heals herself and the nearest ally every 15s; extended fights against her go the way Grievous Wounds decides.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and content.early say Kayle auto-pokes you at level 1 with range.
audit.why: Divine Ascent grants attack range as she levels; at level 1 she is melee, which is exactly why the level-1 row is even. The full layer already says this — the content layer contradicted it.
audit.corrected: whys[0] and content.early rewritten so both layers say the same thing.

edits.before: Track Divine Judgment (R) above all — her invulnerability is the only thing that survives your all-in; note when she ults so you can commit Highlander resets while it's down. Pre-6, watch her E (Starfire Spellblade) for the ranged poke and slow that lets her trade back.
edits.after: Track Divine Judgment (R) above all — 160s at rank 1, so one baited ult buys you the whole lane; commit Highlander resets while it's down. Pre-6 watch Radiant Blast (Q), 12s for a 900-range slow and resist shred, and Starfire Spellblade (E) on 8s as her auto reset.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges nothing of Kayle's reliably (her E slow and ranged autos still land on exit), but it gives you the attack-reset and gap-close she can't punish in melee form; her Divine Judgment invuln is the single counter to your Highlander reset-kill chain, so it dictates when you commit.
edits.after: Radiant Blast (Q) is the slow, not her E, and it shreds your resistances — but Wuju Style's true damage ignores resistances entirely, so the shred buys her nothing against your main damage. Starfire Spellblade (E) is an auto reset that scales on your missing health, so its wind-up is the cue to leave. Divine Judgment is the one counter to your Highlander reset chain.

edits.before: Don't dump your full E + Q + autos while Divine Judgment is up — poke her to force the invuln or wait it out, then all-in so your Highlander resets actually land the kill.
edits.after: Don't dump E + Q + autos while Divine Judgment is up — it's 160s at rank 1, so forcing it once leaves nearly three minutes with no invuln to save her; then all-in.

edits.before: Kraken Slayer or Blade of the Ruined King first for the on-hit spike that bursts her before two items, then Wit's End (its magic resist and on-hit shred is ideal vs her AP ranged form), Berserker's Greaves, and Terminus/Maw later for the MR and lifesteal to survive her scaling DPS.
edits.after: Kraken Slayer or Blade of the Ruined King first for the on-hit spike that bursts her before two items, then Wit's End for the magic resist against her ranged form. Celestial Blessing (W) heals her every 15s, so bring Grievous Wounds to any extended fight; Berserker's Greaves, then Terminus or Maw.

edits.before: A true coin-flip (50.65%) scaling mirror — you own levels 2 through first item and must win there, because Kayle reclaims everything at two items and into the late game.
edits.after: A near coin-flip (54.36%) scaling mirror — you own levels 2 through first item and must win there, because Kayle reclaims everything at two items and into the late game.

edits.before: Level 1 is even as Kayle's ranged auto pokes you.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: Kayle is still melee like you.

edits.before: Level 1 is a skill matchup as she can auto-poke, but from level 2 onward Kayle is a slow melee with no defense and you dominate every trade with Wuju true damage.
edits.after: Level 1 is even because Kayle is melee too, and from level 2 she is a slow meleer with no defence, so you dominate every trade with Wuju Style's true damage.

edits.before: Kayle is the scariest scaling top in the game: if she reaches her item breakpoints she becomes a ranged hyper-carry with true damage that out-duels you, so you must snowball early and end fast.
edits.after: Kayle is the scariest scaling top in the game: at her item breakpoints she becomes a ranged hyper-carry whose magic damage out-duels you from outside your 600 Q, so snowball early and end fast.

edits.before: Once Kayle hits her item breakpoints she out-ranges and out-scales you with waves and true damage, turning the game if she survived lane.
edits.after: Once Kayle hits her item breakpoints she out-ranges you with wave-of-fire autos and magic damage, turning the game if she survived lane.

notes: Two ability-ownership errors fixed: the slow and the poke belong to Radiant Blast (Q, 900 range, 12s, resist shred), not Starfire Spellblade (E, 550, 8s, auto reset on missing health). Kayle deals magic damage, not true damage — that claim appeared twice. Win rate in report[14].t was 50.65% against a packet value of 54.36%.
